name: agent launch
wording: a session can be started as any agent the corpus delivers, with the identity it has when dispatched, while its reach is granted by whoever starts it: the operator for a main session, the dispatcher within the ceiling its definition declares for a subagent; it is reached through the harness's own way of starting a session, or cratylus's extension to it, so one definition serves both and nothing outside the harness wraps it.
reason: The operator starts sessions as agents such as the architect, mav or kino; a launcher outside the harness is a second definition that drifts, and an agent's text must read the same however it was started.
